hero.title: Software Engineer
hero.description: A fresh Software Engineering graduate based in Makassar, passionate about self-hosted infrastructure, advanced networking, and web development. Engineering robust solutions from bare metal to the cloud.

experience.description: Spearheading initiatives to educate peers on modern infrastructure, orchestrating workshops on Docker, Linux administration, and self-hosted deployments.
Managing team logistics and overseeing technical event operations to ensure seamless execution of community gatherings and digital integrations.
Contributed to student council governance, developing leadership and organizational skills while integrating technical solutions into administrative tasks.

projects.title: Self-Hosted Cloud Infrastructure
projects.description: Designed and deployed a robust home-lab environment utilizing Docker and CasaOS on Armbian Linux. Implemented Nextcloud for secure, private data storage and sync across devices.

projects.title: Distributed Database Networking
projects.description: Engineered a secure, zero-trust mesh network using Tailscale to link geographically distributed MariaDB instances, ensuring high availability and encrypted internal traffic without exposing ports.

projects.title: Exarabia Product Innovation
projects.description: Developed a full-stack web application focusing on clean UI/UX principles to showcase product innovations. Integrated backend PHP logic with a responsive, modern frontend.
